# Third-party fixture notices

These notices cover the HTML in `real/`, copied text in its annotations,
`curated.json`, and Markdown/metadata in `captured/`. They are separate from
htomd's MIT licence. Keep this file, [LICENSES.txt](LICENSES.txt), and the
[manifest](real/manifest.json) with redistributed fixtures or extracts.

The manifest identifies every original page, title, attribution, retrieval date,
original response hash, current snapshot hash, and applicable terms. Source links
also identify contributors through the original page/history. Existing in-page
credits and copyright notices remain applicable. No source endorses htomd.

## Changes made on 9 September 2026

Executable scripts, site-settings JSON (including embedded credentials), stylesheet
blocks, SVG artwork, frames, event handlers and embedded data URLs were removed.
Empty inert templates preserve text boundaries. JSON-LD article metadata,
article text, code examples, links and externally hosted image
references remain. External image, font, script and stylesheet files are not
included. The originals are kept locally outside this repository. Captured
Markdown is an extracted and reformatted version of the source; block inventories
contain excerpts. Captured Markdown uses `.txt` files so GitHub displays the
source without loading third-party images. These transformations do not grant
additional rights.

## Government sources

No copyright is claimed in original U.S. Government works. The following credits
apply to the named fixture prefixes and their associated outputs. Individual
policies govern reuse; linked photographs and other external works retain their
own rights. No downloaded photographs are included.

| Prefix | Source credit | Reuse policy |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nasa-gov-*` | National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) | [Policy](https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/) |
| `noaa-gov-*` | National Ocean Service, National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) | [Policy](https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/disclaimer.html) |
| `nist-gov-*` | National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) | [Policy](https://www.nist.gov/copyrights-disclaimers) |
| `energy-gov-*` | U.S. Department of Energy | [Policy](https://www.energy.gov/web-policies) |
| `nih-gov-*` | National Institute of General Medical Sciences, National Institutes of Health | [Policy](https://www.nigms.nih.gov/Pages/Disclaimers) |
| `medlineplus-gov-*` | Source: MedlinePlus, National Library of Medicine. | [Policy](https://medlineplus.gov/about/using/usingcontent/) |
| `nps-gov-*` | National Park Service | [Policy](https://www.nps.gov/aboutus/disclaimer.htm) |
| `state-gov-*` | Office of the Historian, U.S. Department of State | [Policy](https://2021-2025.state.gov/copyright-information/) |
| `archives-gov-*` | National Archives and Records Administration | [Policy](https://www.archives.gov/global-pages/privacy.html) |
| `nsf-gov-*` | Courtesy: U.S. National Science Foundation | [Policy](https://www.nsf.gov/policies/digital) |
| `genome-gov-*` | Courtesy: National Human Genome Research Institute | [Policy](https://www.genome.gov/about-nhgri/Policies-Guidance/Copyright) |
| `census-gov-*` | U.S. Census Bureau | [Policy](https://www.census.gov/about/policies.html) |

Archives-produced works are also offered under CC0. NIST fixtures contain
explanatory pages and links, not a downloaded Standard Reference Database.
EPA snapshots are excluded because the source policy does not clearly permit
commercial redistribution ([policy](https://www.epa.gov/web-policies-and-procedures/epa-disclaimers)).

## Wikimedia and Creative Commons

`wikimedia-org-*`, `wikipedia-org-*`, `wiktionary-org-*` and `wikibooks-org-*`
contain contributions under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).
Attribution for each page is in the manifest, with source/history links.
Sanitised copies and extracted text retain CC BY-SA 4.0, including our changes;
preserve attribution and identify further modifications. Credits for quoted or
imported material remain in the source HTML.

Diff article credits: Community Resources Team (`02`), Sir Amugi (`03`),
Moheen Reeyad and Wikimedia Bangladesh (`04`), Sandister Tei (WMF) (`05`).
The index (`01`) credits its listed authors.

`wikisource-org-*` site contributions have the same CC BY-SA terms. The pages
for Ozymandias and Sonnet 18 identify their public-domain sources. The Road Not
Taken fixture is a versions/index page; it does not reproduce the poem.

`creativecommons-org-*`: Creative Commons dedicates the deeds and accompanying
notices to [CC0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/); other site
prose uses [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). See the
[licensing statement](https://creativecommons.org/policies/#legalcode).

`gnu-org-02` contains the Hyper Estraier search form, copyright 2004–2007 Mikio

and styles were removed; the modified HTML source is supplied in this repository.
The [upstream source](https://dbmx.net/hyperestraier/hyperestraier-1.4.13.tar.gz)
is also available. `gnu-org-03` credits the Free Software Foundation and retains
